column1: Number of Code Blocks per Sub-Frame (Note 3)

Note 1:For FDD mode, all 10 subframes are available for MBMS, in line with TS 36.331 [7].Note 2:Zero OFDM symbols are reserved for PDCCH; and no CRS allocated as per TS 36.211 [4].Note 3:If more than one Code Block is present, an additional CRC sequence of L = 24 Bits is attached to each Code Block (otherwise L = 0 Bit).
